review_findings: Original stream_base.cc151-173 and660-669 preserved: absent/retired native receiver returns undefined, IsAlive precedes argument CHECKs and trigger handling, then concrete method dispatch.

Original src_env.cc264-285 preserved: kCheck>0 asserts async_id>=0; actual previous default trigger is restored. Environment is retained and async id copied before invocation; no stream/AsyncWrap/virtual access follows it.

GetFD missing/dead returns UV_EINVAL without trigger scope; original virtual default remains -1. Counter getters bypass IsAlive and perform uint64-to-double Number conversion, returning zero for absent native state.
Four FileHandle adapters delegate directly to existing IsAlive/GetFD/Reader.start/Reader.stop; closing stays alive, so actual ReadStart UV_EOF remains distinguishable from dead JSMethod UV_EINVAL.
Shutdown keeps the object CHECK and existing native request owner. UseUserBuffer keeps existing CustomBuffer native owner; neither receives a substitute success implementation.

All13 controls read. Concrete file I/O, request completion, CustomBuffer listener publication and shutdown use current Main fixtures; explicit test virtual probes isolate selected failure, nested scope and receiver-destruction semantics.
Pure virtual defaults remain absent dependencies; no partial public constructor/AddMethods surface is installed. Existing ActualFileHandleCallbackTemplateRequired guard remains untouched.
Build adds only an install target and reuses current CustomBuffer link/include/allocation.cpp closure. Native parser/semantic analysis has not occurred.
